why: The mechanism has early RL steps concentrating the policy on the base's own high-probability paths, so step-100 finished answers already have higher per-token log-prob than the cued base's median. The shift is only partial because step 100 comes before most of the entropy drop (73 % by step 200 of 2,400) and sits at the neuron noise floor, so the share is above 0.5 but modest.

By step 400, most of the early entropy collapse has happened (the first phase), so most step-400 finished answers should be sharper per token than the cued base's median, though not yet at the level of the fully trained model.

If roughly three quarters of the entropy loss comes early (2505.22617), step 400's median per-token log-prob should cover most of the cued-base-to-step-2,800 distance. I widened the interval because the later loop removal and longer deliberation could move step 2,800's median either way.
